name: hmi_render_json
description: Render exported Unified HMI JSON offline to lossless PNG previews, numbered layout overlays and geometry/warnings reports. Resolves static nested screen windows; never connects to TIA or executes scripts. Complex controls use explicit placeholders.

input_directory.description: Export directory containing manifest.json. Full exports or compact exports with defaultsFile give best fidelity.

output_directory.description: Separate output directory for PNGs, layout reports and render-index.json. Existing output files are never overwritten.

screen_name.description: Optional screen name or group/name path; omitted renders every exported screen.

language.description: Text language from manifest (default: en-US when available, otherwise first exported language).

scale.description: Output pixels per screen pixel, 0.5 to 4 (default: 2). Maximum 8192 per axis and 32 megapixels.
